notes: REN-BI v1.5: integração preferencial por VIEWS dbo.vw_renbi_*. Execute database/sqlserver/01_views_renbi_adapter.sql, mapeie apenas as VIEWS BASE nos pontos comentados e depois habilite as entidades abaixo. Nunca coloque senha neste arquivo.

management_daily.label: Indicadores gerenciais por dia
management_daily.description: Fluxos diários e saldos. Alimenta filtros Dia/Mês/Ano, Dashboard e Projeções.
management_daily.query: SELECT TOP (5000) CONVERT(varchar(10), [date], 23) AS date, revenue, sales, purchases, gross_profit, expenses, net_profit, inventory, receivables, payables, cash FROM dbo.vw_renbi_management_daily ORDER BY [date] DESC

summary.label: Resumo executivo
summary.description: KPIs móveis do período mais recente.
summary.query: SELECT TOP (1) revenue, sales, purchases, gross_profit, expenses, net_profit, inventory, receivables, payables, cash FROM dbo.vw_renbi_summary

sales_daily.label: Vendas diárias
sales_daily.description: Resultado diário de vendas, pedidos, ticket médio e meta.
sales_daily.query: SELECT TOP (1200) CONVERT(varchar(10), [date], 23) AS date, sales, target, orders, avg_ticket FROM dbo.vw_renbi_sales_daily ORDER BY [date] DESC

products.label: Produtos e desempenho
products.description: Produtos mais/menos vendidos com quantidade, receita, custo e estoque.
products.query: SELECT TOP (20000) product_id, product, quantity, revenue, cost, stock FROM dbo.vw_renbi_product_sales ORDER BY revenue DESC

inventory.label: Estoque analítico
inventory.description: Estoque, valor a custo, consumo médio, mínimo e máximo.
inventory.query: SELECT TOP (30000) product_id, product, stock, cost_value, avg_daily_sales, min_stock, max_stock FROM dbo.vw_renbi_inventory_analytics ORDER BY cost_value DESC

purchase_suggestions.label: Sugestões de compra e não compra
purchase_suggestions.description: Cobertura, quantidade sugerida e recomendação por produto.
purchase_suggestions.query: SELECT TOP (30000) product_id, product, stock, avg_daily_sales, min_stock, max_stock, days_cover, suggested_quantity, recommendation FROM dbo.vw_renbi_purchase_suggestions ORDER BY CASE recommendation WHEN 'COMPRAR' THEN 1 WHEN 'MONITORAR' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, days_cover

accounts_receivable.label: Contas a receber
accounts_receivable.description: Títulos a receber, recebidos e vencidos.
accounts_receivable.query: SELECT TOP (30000) CONVERT(varchar(10), due_date, 23) AS due_date, counterparty, description, value, paid_value, status, title_id, customer_id, CONVERT(varchar(10), payment_date, 23) AS payment_date FROM dbo.vw_renbi_accounts_receivable ORDER BY due_date

accounts_payable.label: Contas a pagar
accounts_payable.description: Títulos a pagar, pagos e vencidos.
accounts_payable.query: SELECT TOP (30000) CONVERT(varchar(10), due_date, 23) AS due_date, counterparty, description, value, paid_value, status, title_id, supplier_id, CONVERT(varchar(10), payment_date, 23) AS payment_date, cost_center_id, category FROM dbo.vw_renbi_accounts_payable ORDER BY due_date

debtors.label: Devedores
debtors.description: Clientes em atraso com valor, títulos e dias de atraso.
debtors.query: SELECT TOP (10000) customer_id, customer, overdue_value, overdue_titles, max_days_overdue FROM dbo.vw_renbi_debtors WHERE overdue_value > 0 ORDER BY overdue_value DESC

suppliers.label: Desempenho de fornecedores
suppliers.description: Gasto, índice de preço, entrega, qualidade e condições.
suppliers.query: SELECT TOP (10000) supplier_id, name, spend, price_index, delivery, quality, terms FROM dbo.vw_renbi_supplier_performance ORDER BY spend DESC

supplier_prices.label: Comparação de preços por fornecedor
supplier_prices.description: Melhor custo por produto e ranking de preço.
supplier_prices.query: SELECT TOP (30000) product_id, product, supplier_id, supplier, CONVERT(varchar(10), last_purchase_date, 23) AS last_purchase_date, last_cost, best_cost, price_rank, payment_term_days, delivery_days, quality_score FROM dbo.vw_renbi_supplier_price_comparison ORDER BY product, price_rank

sellers.label: Vendedores e metas
sellers.query: SELECT TOP (3000) seller_id, name, target, actual, team FROM dbo.vw_renbi_seller_performance ORDER BY actual DESC

seller_products.label: Produtos por vendedor
seller_products.description: Mais e menos vendidos por vendedor, receita, custo e margem.
seller_products.query: SELECT TOP (50000) seller_id, seller, product_id, product, quantity, revenue, cost, gross_margin FROM dbo.vw_renbi_seller_product_sales ORDER BY seller, revenue DESC

expenses.label: Despesas
expenses.description: Despesas por data, centro de custo, categoria e tipo.
expenses.query: SELECT TOP (50000) CONVERT(varchar(10), [date], 23) AS date, cost_center, category, description, value, fixed_variable, expense_id, cost_center_id FROM dbo.vw_renbi_expenses_analytics ORDER BY [date] DESC

accounting_entries.label: Lançamentos contábeis
accounting_entries.description: Base para DRE, DMPL e Balanço Patrimonial.
accounting_entries.query: SELECT TOP (100000) CONVERT(varchar(10), entry_date, 23) AS date, account_code, account_name, statement_group, description, debit, credit, cost_center_id FROM dbo.vw_renbi_accounting_entries ORDER BY entry_date DESC
